column2: [intro]
Grab the basketball, soccer, or tennis,
Mental strength’s the trick to being the best,
When pressure’s high, you must resist,
Stay focused and don’t shy away from the test.
In sports, don’t let it slip away,
Mental strength’s key, it’s here to stay,
With conviction and determination in sight,
We can achieve anything, no matter the fight.
When you play, be like a lion,
Face your fears, leave them behind,
Visualize your win, it's close at hand,
With courage and boldness, you'll command the land.
Mental strength is the winning strategy,
In our minds, we create our own reality,
No matter the challenge or the strife,
With mental power, we conquer life.
[ solo ]
In sports, don’t let it slip away,
Mental strength’s key, it’s here to stay,
With conviction and determination in sight,
We can achieve anything, no matter the fight.
